@pytest.fixture(scope="class", autouse=True)
def class_setup(cls, request, android_hpx_flow_setup, load_printers_session):
    cls = cls.__class__
    cls.driver, cls.fc = android_hpx_flow_setup
    cls.p = load_printers_session
    # Define flows
    cls.device_mfe = cls.fc.hpx_fd["devicesMFE"]
    cls.hpx_printer_details = cls.fc.fd[FLOW_NAMES.HPX_PRINTERS_DETAILS]
    cls.printers = cls.fc.fd[FLOW_NAMES.PRINTERS]
    cls.hpx_shortcuts = cls.fc.fd[FLOW_NAMES.HPX_SHORTCUTS]
    # Enable HPX Flag
    cls.fc.hpx = True

def test_01_verify_the_screen_when_the_user_enables_only_the_email_destination_in_the_add_shortcut_screen(self):
        """
        Description: C63
        Steps:
            1.Install and Launch the HPX app.
            2.Click on the printer icon on the root view screen.
            3.Then click on the shortcuts tile on the device details page.
            4.Click on the Add new shortcuts in shortcuts screen.
            5.Then click on the Create your own shortcut arrow button.
            6.Enable only the 'Email' destination toggle bar in 'Add Shortcut' screen.
            7.Then click on the Continue button.
            8.Verify the screen.
        Expected Result:
            User should be navigated to the 'Add Email' screen.
        """
        self.fc.reset_app()
        self.fc.flow_load_home_screen(skip_value_prop=False)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_add_device_btn()
        self.printers.search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_printer_device_card()
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_shortcuts_tile(raise_e=False)
        self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_shortcuts_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_add_new_shortcut_btn()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_create_your_own_shortcut()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_edit_shortcut_email_toggle_btn()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_edit_shortcut_continue_btn()
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_edit_shortcut_email_screen_title()

automation_scripts_rules.description: One-to-Many Test Step Mapping with Sequential Script Execution
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps that require multiple sequential script calls to complete (e.g., Precondition 1, Step 1)
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step maps to multiple script calls connected by → symbols
THEN: Split the step into sub-steps (1a, 1b, 1c, etc.) where each sub-step maps to one script call
IMPLEMENTATION: Execute all script calls in exact sequence order, ensure each completes before proceeding to next

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps that map directly to a single script call (e.g., Step 2, Step 4, Step 6, Step 7)
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step maps to exactly one script call
THEN: Execute the single script call directly
IMPLEMENTATION: No sub-step splitting required, execute script call and verify completion

automation_scripts_rules.description: Implicit Step Insertion for Test Execution Validation
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases involving screen navigation and state verification like 'Verify the screen when the user enables only the Email destination in the Add Shortcut screen'
rule_definition: WHEN: Executing test cases that involve screen transitions or critical state changes
THEN: Insert implicit verification steps after navigation actions even if not explicitly mentioned in original test steps
IMPLEMENTATION: Add 'Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution' with verify_*_screen_title() calls after each navigation action

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test cases requiring printer setup and user authentication
rule_definition: WHEN: Test case has preconditions for printer setup and user login
THEN: Always start with self.fc.reset_app() followed by environment setup sequence
IMPLEMENTATION: Precondition 1 must include reset_app → flow_load_home_screen → device setup sequence

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All navigation steps in HPX app automation
rule_definition: WHEN: Any step involves clicking to navigate to a new screen
THEN: Follow with implicit verification step to confirm screen loaded correctly
IMPLEMENTATION: Use verify_*_screen_title() methods to validate successful navigation before proceeding

automation_scripts_rules.description: Toggle State Management for Destination Selection
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps involving destination toggle configuration in shortcut creation
rule_definition: WHEN: Test step requires enabling/disabling specific destination toggles
THEN: Implement comprehensive toggle state verification and management
IMPLEMENTATION: Check current state, disable unwanted toggles, enable required toggles, verify final state matches requirements

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Final verification steps in test cases
rule_definition: WHEN: Test step is 'Verify the screen' or similar final validation
THEN: Use assert statement with verification method
IMPLEMENTATION: assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_*_screen_title() to ensure test fails if verification fails

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Actions that may not be available in all test scenarios
rule_definition: WHEN: Script call includes raise_e=False parameter
THEN: Handle potential element not found scenarios gracefully
IMPLEMENTATION: Allow script to continue execution even if element is not immediately available

automation_scripts_rules.description: Flow-Based Screen Loading with Value Proposition Handling
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Home screen loading in HPX app
rule_definition: WHEN: Loading home screen using flow_load_home_screen
THEN: Handle value proposition screens based on skip_value_prop parameter
IMPLEMENTATION: Use skip_value_prop=False to ensure all onboarding screens are properly handled
